analysis: Documentation-only units examined. docs/developer/test.md head lines 1838-2578 in this batch are unchanged surrounding text (the changed range is head 1043-1085, the new 'Cluster Pair Coordinated Update' test section, which is visible only in the file_changes excerpt and not in these units). They describe CPU/synthetic checks, including the cluster prefix tenant partition at lines 2209-2230, which relates to T-041/SEC-035. No change to cache-scope semantics is visible here. docs/provider/cli-reference.md head 1804-1810 documents that `darkbloom update` on a cluster Mac asks the cluster service supervisor to restart both Macs into the installed release after the pair drains, with a deferral exiting 1. Head 2148 extends the auto_update description to the pair's coordinated update slot. The documented update path still verifies bundle, binary and metallib hashes (SelfUpdater.swift); the docs claim no weakened verification. Integration questions are outside the supplied evidence: UpdateCommand.swift, ClusterServiceUpdateRequest and ClusterPairUpdateCycle. Integration should check that (a) the partner Mac cannot force an install or rollback of an unverified release over the pair channel (T-013/T-043: the watchdog/rollback authority is the same replaceable binary); (b) candidate promotion/rollback keeps the signed-artifact identity checks of A-011/A-017/T-054; and (c) the drain/defer logic cannot be abused by a peer to hold the other Mac out of serving indefinitely (A-018 availability). The docs say auto_update off on a partner prevents slot downloads. No regression is shown in these documentation units.
